newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Maybank in $38 mln loan deal with GTM.
newsitem.headline: Maybank in $38 mln loan deal with GTM.

text.p: Malayan Banking Bhd and its subsidiary, Aseambankers Malaysia Bhd said on Monday they have signed a $38 million syndicated term-loan agreement with a joint company which is expanding Phnom Penh's airport.
In a statement, Aseambankers said the agreement was signed on Monday in Phnom Penh with Societe Concessionaire de L'Aeroport (SCA).
SCA is a Cambodian joint venture company owned by France's GTM-Entrepose and Muhibbah Masteron Cambodia JV Ltd on a 70:30 basis.
Muhibbah has two Malaysian shareholders in Muhibbah Engineering Bhd and Masteron Sdn Bhd, and a Cambodian partner, Kong Triv.
The facility will be utlised to part-finance the expansion and upgrading cost of the existing Pochentong Airport and construction of a new passenger terminal.

The total cost of the project is $100 million which will be financed by the term loan, a French government grant, capital injection and advances by shareholders and from the project cash flow, Aseambankers said.

When phase one of the terminal is completed, it will be able to accommodate international flights of up to a capacity of one million passengers a year. The statement did not say when the project would be completed.
The Cambodian government has awarded a 10-year concession to SCA on a build-operate-transfer basis. Works started in October 1995.
